(2) PRE-EXISTING BUG found in live smoke, reproduced on prior prod binaries so NOT caused by this work: harness --exit-when-idle child produces result then hangs forever in #[tokio::main] runtime drop (BlockingPool::shutdown joins the parked tokio::io::stdin blocking read, which never EOFs because daemon holds child stdin open); child never exits so daemon never publishes terminal, every bro_exec stuck at 'running' with zombie child. Error path already did process::exit(1); success path fell through. Fix: process::exit(0) on Ok in main.rs (durability already satisfied - snapshot+event log flushed at turn boundary). Verified live: status Completed in 5s, zero lingering children, exit relayed via fleetd. Branch fix/harness-idle-exit-hang (a16dd3a) pushed, harness redeployed, full lane verify running.
